author: thesmegmagician
quote: This game is everything wrong with corporations making artistic decisions in gaming. It was made in a lab with 100 lawyers and stock analysists to be the most inoffensive sludge possible to market to people that dont care about video games because when your game has a budget in the billions you depend on marketing to people that aren't in your audience. Ans when Rockstar had the audacity to only charge 80 dollars the stock went down because Wallstreet wanted them to sodomize us harder knowing that there are idiots out there who would pay $400 for gta just for the name. It was clearly made for the next gen and runs like garbage on anything but the ps pro, but the only people who own that are the "journalists" who are in bed with take2 from the start.I hope this game is a cautionary tale, but it wont be because normies love their goyslop
